environment.description: IoT device message handler deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e9b1d4e5f6) in VPC vpc-0abc123def456789. Service runs on port 8443 behind an internet-facing ALB (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/iot-msg-handler/50dc6c495c0c9188). ALB security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8 allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Instance security group sg-0z9y8x7w6v5u4t3s2 allows inbound 8443 from the ALB security group. No egress restrictions on the instance - full outbound internet and VPC access. Instance has IAM role with IMDS v1 enabled (HttpTokens: optional). DNS resolution is handled by VPC resolver with no response policy zones configured.
